title: Bridging the Gap: Integrating Ethics and Environmental Sustainability in AI Research and Practice

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptual evaluation and literature review highlighting spatial disparities in AI training data, specifically noting the underrepresentation of the Global South and specific geographic biomes in both human-centric datasets and ecological/biodiversity data.

Theoretical analysis of structural power dynamics, evaluating how resource-intensive AI development paradigms amplify wealth disparities, exclude resource-constrained communities, and exploit marginalized populations for labor and environmental costs.
